management_steps.details: Head lice: apply to towel-dried or dry hair, leave on up to 1 hour, repeat every 5 days for 3 weeks. Scabies (children < 6 years or adults when benzoyl benzoate unsuccessful): apply lotion undiluted to whole body from neck to feet, leave on overnight (8 to 12 hours) and wash off following morning.
Avoid contact with eyes and broken skin or sores. Toxic if swallowed.

warnings: Toxic if swallowed. Avoid contact with eyes and broken skin or sores.
